sentences.text: The petition has been filed by one of the accused in the aforesaid first information reports, which have been mentioned in the prayer clause quoted above.
It is settled law that the accused has no right to claim directions as to the manner in which a case against him investigated nor he has any right to choose the investigating agency.
The instant writ petition, therefore, filed by the accused, is clearly not maintainable.
It is dismissed as not maintainable.
